SHOP.physical_anchor: None — Shopify is a cloud e-commerce/SaaS platform; it does not make, move, or power anything physical.
SHOP.value_chain_position: Cloud commerce/SaaS platform selling subscription and payments software to merchants; no physical product anywhere in the value chain.

SITM.physical_anchor: Fabricates MEMS-based silicon precision-timing oscillators and clock ICs — a real chip, but a general-purpose timing component, not qubit/cryo/photonic hardware.
SITM.value_chain_position: Precision-timing semiconductor supplier (MEMS oscillators/clocks) sold broadly into networking, datacenter, industrial and automotive customers — not dedicated to any FDT chain.

SKHY.physical_anchor: Manufactures DRAM and NAND flash memory chips, including HBM used in AI accelerators — real semiconductor hardware, but general memory, not quantum-computing hardware.
SKHY.value_chain_position: Memory semiconductor manufacturer (DRAM/NAND/HBM) selling into AI/datacenter and consumer electronics broadly — the FMP quantum industry filter caught a memory-chip maker, not a quantum-chain company.

SMTC.physical_anchor: Designs analog/mixed-signal, LoRa IoT and optical/copper signal-integrity chips for data centers — real chips, but not tied to any FDT chain's physical thesis.
SMTC.value_chain_position: Analog/IoT/signal-integrity semiconductor supplier diversified across data-center connectivity and industrial IoT — no dedicated FDT-chain exposure.

SNDK.physical_anchor: Manufactures NAND flash memory chips and storage products (SSDs, memory cards) — physical hardware, but general storage, not quantum hardware.
SNDK.value_chain_position: NAND flash/storage device manufacturer selling into consumer and enterprise storage markets — no FDT-chain fit.

SNN.physical_anchor: Makes the CORI robotic-assisted surgical system for knee/hip procedures plus orthopedic implants and surgical instruments — a real robotic-surgery platform.
SNN.value_chain_position: Surgical robotics & orthopedic device maker — CORI robotic platform drives implant pull-through, alongside wound-care/sports-medicine franchises unrelated to the chain.

SOLV.physical_anchor: Manufactures wound-care/surgical supplies, dental products and lab purification/filtration equipment — physical products, but no robotics or automation anchor.
SOLV.value_chain_position: Diversified healthcare/industrial products maker (wound care, dental, health IT, purification & filtration) spun off from 3M — no FDT-chain fit.

SPSC.physical_anchor: None — cloud EDI/retail supply-chain SaaS network; no physical product.
SPSC.value_chain_position: Cloud-based retail supply-chain data/EDI network — software only, no FDT-chain exposure.

SRAD.value_chain_position: Sports-data and odds/betting-technology provider — pure software/data services, no FDT-chain exposure.

SSNC.physical_anchor: None — financial-services back-office and fund-administration software.
SSNC.value_chain_position: Enterprise software for asset management, fund administration and healthcare back-office — no physical FDT-chain exposure.

STM.physical_anchor: Fabricates a broad line of analog, MCU, MEMS-sensor and power (including SiC) semiconductor chips — real silicon, but a diversified automotive/industrial chipmaker with no dedicated quantum or grid-equipment identity.
STM.value_chain_position: Diversified analog/MCU/power/MEMS semiconductor manufacturer serving automotive, industrial and consumer markets broadly — the quantum industry filter caught a generic large-cap chipmaker.

STRL.physical_anchor: Physically builds and grades data-center/e-commerce distribution-center sites and executes electrical/grid-interconnection civil construction — genuine EPC/construction on physical infrastructure.
STRL.value_chain_position: E-Infrastructure/EPC contractor — site development and civil/electrical construction for data centers and grid-interconnection projects (toll-taker on the interconnection-queue backlog).

STVN.physical_anchor: Manufactures glass primary-packaging (vials, syringes, cartridges) and drug-delivery devices for pharma/biotech — physical products, but not robotics/automation.
STVN.value_chain_position: Pharma packaging & drug-delivery device manufacturer (glass vials, pre-fillable syringes) — no FDT-chain fit.

STX.physical_anchor: Manufactures hard-disk-drive (HDD) storage devices for hyperscale/enterprise datacenters — real physical hardware, but general storage, not quantum hardware.
STX.value_chain_position: HDD/data-storage device manufacturer selling into hyperscale and enterprise datacenter storage — no FDT-chain fit.

SWKS.physical_anchor: Manufactures RF front-end semiconductor modules for smartphones and wireless devices — real chips, but consumer-wireless focused, not quantum hardware.
SWKS.value_chain_position: RF/analog semiconductor supplier for mobile and wireless connectivity — no FDT-chain exposure.

SYK.physical_anchor: Makes the Mako robotic-arm-assisted surgical system for joint reconstruction plus orthopedic implants and surgical instruments — a leading physical surgical-robotics platform.
SYK.value_chain_position: Surgical robotics & orthopedic/medtech device maker — Mako robotic platform is the flagship capital-equipment franchise driving implant pull-through.

SYM.physical_anchor: Designs, manufactures and deploys autonomous robots and automated storage/retrieval structures inside warehouse fulfillment centers — genuine physical robotics hardware.
SYM.value_chain_position: Warehouse-robotics/automation systems integrator — builds and licenses robotic fulfillment-center hardware+software (Walmart flagship customer); the electrification/power/nuclear hints on this name are keyword noise, not a genuine second chain.

TDC.physical_anchor: None — cloud/on-prem data-warehousing and analytics software.
TDC.value_chain_position: Enterprise data-warehouse and analytics software vendor — no physical FDT-chain exposure.

TDY.physical_anchor: Manufactures machine-vision and infrared/thermal-imaging cameras and sensors (FLIR, DALSA, e2v brands) plus precision instrumentation used in industrial inspection and robotic guidance.
TDY.value_chain_position: Machine-vision/imaging-sensor and precision-instrumentation manufacturer — the Digital Imaging segment (FLIR/DALSA) is the toll-taker into factory-automation and robotic-vision deployments, alongside unrelated aerospace/defense and marine instrumentation businesses.

TEL.physical_anchor: Manufactures electrical/electronic connectors, power-distribution components and sensors used in grid, data-center and EV power-management systems — a genuine physical connector/power-management maker.
TEL.value_chain_position: Power-management & connectivity component maker — sells connectors and sensors into grid power distribution, data-center and EV electrification build-out (the chain's 'power management & connectors' layer); the FMP 'Semiconductors' classification is a filing quirk, not TEL's real business.
